categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel public C API header in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h.
categories.rationale: Clarifies the API contract to prevent undefined behavior in foreign language bindings when handling zero-length buffers. As noted in the description, btck_witness_stack_get_item_at can pass a null pointer via std::vector::data() for empty elements, which binding authors must handle to avoid crashes or UB when constructing slice views.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the maintainer label, this PR exclusively documents a C API callback in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h without touching or altering validation logic.
categories.rationale: Changes whose primary subject is the kernel library API are explicitly excluded from validation unless they substantively alter validation rules or behavior.
